description: First-party public sources for navigating administrative and daily-life matters in Poland.

sources.title: Office for Foreigners
sources.notes: Use as the national authority landing page. Verify procedure-specific instructions separately.

sources.title: Case Handling Module for residence matters
sources.notes: Public guidance is public-only evidence. With active user authorization a caller-owned Browser or Computer operator may resume after user-controlled authentication to inspect the scoped record, fill a draft and prepare attachments. The user personally performs every signature; final send requires a fresh action-time confirmation. The plugin bundles no authenticated connector.

sources.title: Polish citizenship procedures
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: Route by procedure, residence, and competent voivodeship or consulate.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: Foreigners affairs in Mazowieckie
sources.notes: Local procedures and appointment channels may change independently of national guidance.

sources.title: Foreigners Department in Wielkopolskie
sources.notes: Some appointment options depend on case state. Never guess a case identifier.

sources.title: Foreigners portal in Dolnoslaskie
sources.notes: Preparation, appointment, and document collection may use different local systems.

sources.title: Foreigners affairs in Malopolskie
sources.notes: Confirm the abstract matter before identifying the public appointment landing page, then stop.

sources.title: Obtain a PESEL number as a foreigner
sources.notes: Use the page to prepare. The competent gmina handles the application.

sources.title: Register an address as a foreigner
sources.notes: The public guidance separates EU/EFTA and family-member routes from other third-country routes, permanent from temporary registration, and online from office filing. Online filing is unavailable to a third-country national who is not an EU/EFTA family member, regardless of PESEL. In that office branch, PESEL absence requires personal appearance; PESEL presence may allow a representative but does not create an online route. Verify housing title or owner confirmation, stay-right documents, any later office presentation, and whether the requested procedure also assigns PESEL ex officio.

sources.title: Register a permanent or longer temporary address as a Polish citizen
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: The public service page distinguishes permanent address registration from temporary registration longer than three months and routes the filing to the gmina where the person lives. Use this record for Polish-citizen meldunek, not as a residence-permit source. Verify the current online or office channel, housing evidence and signature requirements before action.

locator.value: Zamelduj sie na pobyt staly lub czasowy dluzszy niz 3 miesiace

sources.title: Permanent address registration for Polish citizens in Warsaw
sources.notes: Warsaw 19115 owns the local permanent-address registration instructions for Polish citizens, including the office and online routes. Use it only when Warsaw is the competent gmina and verify the current office, appointment path, documents and fees before action.

locator.value: Zameldowanie na pobyt staly obywateli Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej

sources.title: Trusted Profile
sources.notes: The user owns authentication, secret entry and every signature action. The agent may explain and navigate to the identity boundary, but it must not capture credentials or sign for the user.

sources.title: Electronic Platform of Public Administration Services
sources.notes: With active user authorization an operator may inspect the addressed service, fill a draft and prepare attachments. Authentication secrets stay with the user, and sending or signing requires action-time confirmation after recipient, content, attachments and legal effect are shown.

sources.title: mObywatel browser portal
sources.notes: This is the public guidance for the separate browser portal, not the mobile app. The protected portal can expose case status, official correspondence, personal registers, applications and payments after login through a currently supported identity method. Service availability evolves; verify the requested service, applicant group and external effect live before using a caller-owned Browser.

sources.title: mObywatel mobile application
sources.notes: This is the public guidance for the smartphone application, distinct from the browser portal. Activation and local access use status-dependent identity confirmation plus an app password or biometrics. Digital documents, forms, payments and signing remain protected user surfaces; verify foreign-national document support and current product availability live and hand the mobile interaction to the user.

sources.title: Identity confirmation methods for mObywatel mobile documents
sources.notes: Official public guidance for supported identity-confirmation routes when adding documents to the mobile application. Methods and provider availability can change; verify the live surface and keep identity-provider selection, secrets and confirmation with the user.

sources.title: Terms of the mObywatel 2.0 mobile application
sources.notes: Official terms ground the mobile application's protected activation and local-access boundary. Re-open the current terms before relying on a specific authentication, biometric, document-presentation, payment or signing behavior.

sources.title: Public registered electronic delivery
sources.notes: Delivery-channel obligations and rollout dates change; verify for the user and recipient.

sources.title: Obtain a civil status record copy
sources.notes: Use for preparation and authority routing, not autonomous ordering.

sources.title: State Labour Inspection employee guidance
sources.notes: Identify the competent inspectorate, preserve evidence and verify the current complaint route and deadline. Drafting and authorized browser operation may be possible through a separate channel, but legal conclusions and sending require an explicit user checkpoint.

sources.title: Legal work by foreign nationals
sources.notes: Use as orientation only; route status-specific questions to current authority instructions.

sources.title: Public employment services
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: Separate public listings from jobseeker and employer procedures. With active user authorization an operator may inspect or fill the selected service. Identity secrets stay private; the authorized user personally performs employer declarations and signatures. Final submission requires a fresh action-time confirmation.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Tax information portal
sources.notes: Prefer current Polish procedure pages when translated material is older.

sources.title: e-Tax Office
sources.notes: With active user authorization an operator may navigate authenticated records and prepare supported tax actions. It must not capture secrets or infer tax correctness; filing, correction, certificate request and payment require action-time confirmation with tax year, form, office, amount and effect visible.

sources.title: Tax office appointments
sources.notes: Verify the competent office and service topic before inspecting live availability. An authorized operator may prepare a booking, reschedule or cancellation, but the selected office, topic, time, contact data and resulting change must be confirmed at action time.

sources.title: Social Insurance Institution
sources.notes: Language selectors do not guarantee that every linked page is translated.

sources.title: eZUS electronic services
sources.notes: PUE and eZUS terminology is transitioning. Confirm the current interface before giving click paths.

sources.title: Business registration and CEIDG services
sources.notes: Public search and guidance are read-only. Registration and changes affect official records.

sources.title: National Court Register search
sources.notes: Use official extracts for evidence. Revalidate any API contract before implementation.

sources.title: REGON API
sources.notes: The documented production service requires a user key. Do not embed credentials in plugin data.

sources.title: TERYT territorial register API
sources.notes: Use to normalize official territorial identifiers, not to infer competent authority alone.

sources.title: Polish Open Data API
sources.notes: Dataset metadata must be checked for provider, coverage date, and update frequency.

sources.title: Public Information Bulletin directory
sources.notes: BIP content is decentralized. Verify the owning authority and publication date on each linked site.

sources.title: Internet Patient Account
sources.authority: Ministry of Health and e-Health Centre
sources.notes: Treat all account and health content as sensitive. With active user authorization an operator may navigate only the requested record or service. Secret entry and declarations are user-only; medical disclosure, provider contact, booking and any account change require least-data handling and a fresh action-time checkpoint.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Health and e-Health Centre

sources.title: National Health Fund patient information
sources.notes: Separate general treatment information from individual insurance entitlement.

sources.title: Social assistance information
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: Local social assistance centres assess individual cases. Do not predict eligibility.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Consumer rights
sources.authority: Office of Competition and Consumer Protection
sources.notes: First establish whether the other party is acting as a business before routing a consumer dispute.
sources.publisher: Office of Competition and Consumer Protection

sources.title: Telecommunications and postal consumer information
sources.notes: Use for sector routing and current public guidance. A complaint may be drafted and, through a supported authorized channel, prepared for sending; verify the provider, service, complaint stage and deadline, then require user confirmation before transmission.

sources.title: Financial Ombudsman
sources.notes: Use after identifying the financial provider and current complaint stage.

sources.title: Family benefits
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: Capture benefit period, household facts, residence status, and current rules before routing.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Good Start education benefit
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: Benefit-year and foreigner-specific conditions can change. Never reuse an older eligibility summary.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Empatia information and services portal
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: Use ministry pages to identify the current channel before directing the user to a form.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Education for children arriving from abroad
sources.notes: Local school and municipality capacity affects the route. Ignore old statistical counts when seeking current procedure.

sources.title: Exchange a foreign driving licence
sources.notes: The service page asks whether the person has lived in Poland for at least 185 days and routes by issuing country, licence type, and the competent starostwo, city office, or Warsaw district office. Verify current conditions and do not decide exchange eligibility or promise processing time.

sources.title: Act on Drivers - consolidated text
sources.authority: Sejm of the Republic of Poland
sources.notes: Articles 5 and 11 use different time concepts: recognition of a qualifying foreign licence and ordinary residence for issuing a Polish licence. Articles 4 and 14 govern recognized documents and exchange. Recheck the consolidated text and amendments before applying either rule to a person.

sources.title: Rail passenger rights
sources.notes: Identify the carrier, journey, and complaint stage before routing.

sources.title: Find a sworn translator
sources.notes: Confirm the receiving authority's document and translation requirements before ordering work.

sources.title: Apostille and document legalization
sources.notes: Determine issuing country, document type, destination, and treaty route before giving a checklist.

sources.title: Recognition of foreign education
sources.authority: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange
sources.notes: Route by education level, issuing country, and purpose. Do not predict recognition.
sources.publisher: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange

sources.title: Emergency number 112
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: Display immediate safety guidance first. Emergency calling and location disclosure remain a user handoff: help the user identify what to say and the current location, but do not capture or transmit either through an unapproved connector.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: National Consulting and Intervention Centre for trafficking victims
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: Prioritize safety and user-controlled contact. Do not expose sensitive narrative in logs.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: Free legal aid for foreigners
sources.notes: Use for human escalation when facts, deadlines, or adverse decisions require individual advice.

sources.title: Your Europe citizens portal
sources.notes: Use for EU cross-border orientation, then confirm the Polish implementing authority.

sources.title: Basic information about the MOS system
sources.notes: The official guidance describes electronic MOS submission from 2026-04-27, listed paper exceptions, electronic signatures, third-party attachments, and later in-person identity steps. Verify the current exception and form before handoff.

locator.value: How can you apply for a residence permit in Poland?

sources.title: CUKR residence-card procedure for former temporary-protection holders
sources.notes: The Office for Foreigners describes the source-defined CUKR applicant groups, status-history conditions, electronic MOS route and current filing window. Treat every condition as a live verification question, not an eligibility conclusion. The applicant personally authenticates and signs; do not freeze fees, deadlines or benefit consequences beyond a dated source observation.

sources.title: Changes to special stay rules for Ukrainian citizens from 5 March 2026
sources.notes: The Office for Foreigners explains which special rules ended on 2026-03-05, which periods continue to 2027-03-04, and which temporary-residence routes remain available to temporary-protection beneficiaries holding PESEL UKR. Do not generalize one extension or exception to every Ukrainian citizen or every UKR-status holder; verify the person's reported status, document, date and procedure.

sources.title: Act phasing out special assistance solutions for Ukrainian citizens
sources.authority: Sejm of the Republic of Poland
sources.notes: Articles 25-26 distinguish two identity-confirmation groups. Article 25 sets 2026-08-31 for a PESEL assigned on the basis of a declaration and provides a 2026-09-01 UKR-to-NUE status change if identity was not confirmed as specified. Article 26 uses a separate 60-day period from travel-document issuance for specified other original-document situations, including invalid or expired documents, subject to its exception. Verify the original PESEL-registration basis and current gmina record; do not collapse these groups or decide legal effect from a user's shorthand description.
sources.publisher: Sejm of the Republic of Poland

sources.title: PESEL UKR identity confirmation and passport-data update notice
sources.notes: The Office for Foreigners ties the 2026-08-31 identity-confirmation deadline to PESEL UKR assigned only on the basis of a declaration without presentation of a valid travel document and states a categorical UKR-status consequence for that group. It separately says a newly issued passport should be updated and that a valid PESEL UKR is required for CUKR. Do not extend the stated consequence to every passport-data change or every PESEL UKR holder; classify the original registration basis against the legal text and preserve the conflict with the broader outreach notice.

locator.value: Declaration-based PESEL UKR records and 31 August 2026 deadline

sources.title: PESEL UKR passport-data update notice for affected records
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: This outreach notice tells Ukrainian citizens with UKR status to check records where PESEL registration lacked a passport, a passport or its data changed, or a child lacked a passport at registration. It highlights 2026-08-31, but its lead says non-update causes status loss while the main Polish and Ukrainian text says it may cause status loss. Its affected-group shorthand is also broader than the declaration-based UdSC notice. Use it for discovery and gmina handoff, preserve both conflicts explicitly, then classify the original registration basis against sejm-ukraine-transition-act-2026; do not apply one deadline or consequence to every PESEL UKR holder.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

locator.value: Affected PESEL UKR passport-data records and 31 August 2026 deadline

sources.title: Permanent residence permit
sources.notes: Use this dedicated national permanent-residence procedure instead of citizenship or EU long-term-resident guidance. Classify the claimed statutory basis, current stay, documentary chain and competent voivode without deciding eligibility. Verify the current MOS form, signature, attachments, in-person follow-up, receipt, fees and deadlines live; do not freeze amounts or processing times.

sources.title: EU Blue Card for highly qualified employment
sources.notes: Use the public requirements and procedure sections for generic routing only. Verify the current salary threshold, qualification route, contract conditions, employer role, mobility rule, and notice duties live; never decide eligibility.

sources.title: SOLVIT problem-solving network
sources.notes: Use only after checking that the issue concerns cross-border EU rights and a public authority.

sources.title: EU citizen and family-member residence routes
sources.notes: Separate EU citizens from EU-family members and from third-country national routes. Registration, permanent-residence and document steps depend on the person's citizenship, relationship, length and continuity of stay, and competent voivode; verify the exact branch and local appointment practice live.

sources.title: MOS checklists for temporary-stay procedures
sources.notes: Choose the checklist only after identifying the exact purpose and applicant category. Required evidence, electronic availability, fees, signature, fingerprints, appointments and voivodeship practice can change; verify all of them live and never treat a checklist as an eligibility decision.

sources.title: MOS main purposes of stay
sources.notes: Use as a purpose classifier, not as a substitute for the current legal and procedural page. Mixed purposes, changed circumstances and status-specific exceptions need live Office for Foreigners and voivodeship verification.

sources.title: Permit for residence of a long-term EU resident
sources.notes: Build a dated stay-history evidence plan but never calculate eligibility from incomplete facts. Absence rules, excluded periods, income, insurance, language evidence, filing method and competent voivode must be verified for the applicant and target date.

locator.value: Permanent residence permit and long-term EU resident's residence permit

sources.title: Apply to be recognised as a Polish citizen
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: Recognition is distinct from presidential grant and confirmation of possession. Route only after collecting the person's legal basis, residence history and locality; verify current evidence, language, fee, appointment and competent-voivode requirements live.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: Confirmation of possession or loss of Polish citizenship
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: Do not infer citizenship from ancestry, documents or family narrative. Establish the relevant life events and authorities, then verify jurisdiction, documentary chain, translations, appointment and current filing route.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: Check personal data in the PESEL register
sources.notes: The record contains personal data. Publicly explain the service and required access method; authenticated inspection requires user control, and any discrepancy must be routed to the competent authority rather than silently corrected.

sources.title: Reserve or withdraw reservation of a PESEL number
sources.notes: Reservation changes the user's official protection state and can affect later transactions. Verify current consequences and channel availability; authenticated navigation may be assisted only under the active operator policy and final reserve or unreserve confirmation belongs to the user.

sources.title: Report a lost or damaged Polish identity card
sources.notes: This route concerns a Polish dowod osobisty. First identify the document, issuer, theft or loss circumstances and immediate safety need. Reporting invalidates the document irreversibly. Verify the current online or office route and prepare a visible summary, but the user must perform the report.

sources.title: Report a lost or destroyed Polish passport
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: This route concerns a Polish passport. A foreign passport must be routed to its issuing state or consular authority. Reporting invalidates the document irreversibly. Verify urgency, current channel and locality and prepare a visible summary, but the user must perform the report.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: Register the birth of a child
sources.notes: Verify who may report, the current time limit, hospital record availability, naming and parentage facts, online-channel availability and the competent civil registry office. Drafting can be assisted, but the user personally performs all declarations; submission requires a fresh action-time confirmation.

sources.title: Civil marriage in Poland
sources.notes: Civil registry office dates, fees, interpreter needs and foreign-document requirements vary by facts and locality. Verify each future spouse's civil status, nationality, documents and the selected USC before any appointment or declaration.

sources.title: Register a death
sources.notes: Use a compassionate, deadline-aware checklist. Verify who is reporting, where the death occurred, the medical death card, competent USC, funeral operator involvement and any foreign or consular dimension; local opening and appointment practice varies.

sources.title: Apply to change a first name or surname
sources.notes: Do not judge whether the stated reason is legally sufficient. Verify the person's status, civil records, competent USC or consular route, current evidence, fee and appointment rules. The user personally performs any declaration; filing requires a fresh action-time confirmation.

sources.title: Your e-PIT online tax return service
sources.notes: Tax year, residence and income facts determine the correct route. A prepared return is not automatically complete or correct; verify the active filing period, supported forms, relief evidence and current acceptance or correction effect, and require confirmation at filing.

sources.title: Personal income tax: basic information
sources.notes: Use for current PIT orientation only. Tax residence, foreign income, treaty treatment, filing form, relief, deadline and competent office require live verification for the relevant tax year; do not infer a tax outcome.

sources.title: Civil-law transactions tax: basic information
sources.notes: Whether PCC applies depends on the transaction, parties, VAT relationship and exemptions. Capture the contract date and transaction facts, then verify the current form, rate, deadline and competent office; never conclude liability from a keyword such as car or loan alone.

sources.title: Pay tax on civil-law transactions
sources.notes: Only route to filing after the transaction and liability branch are verified. Confirm the current form, amount, deadline, office and payment identifier. Filling may be assisted under operator policy, but the user personally performs the declaration; filing and payment initiation require fresh action-time confirmation.

sources.title: Inheritance and donation tax: allowances and exemptions
sources.notes: Relationship group, acquisition type and date, prior acquisitions, location of assets and documentation affect reporting and relief. Verify current thresholds, form, deadline and cross-border treatment live; do not infer exemption.

sources.title: Report inherited or donated property with form SD-Z2
sources.notes: SD-Z2 is not the universal inheritance or donation form. Verify whether it is the correct route, the relevant acquisition date, relationship and evidence, office and current deadline. Submission requires explicit user confirmation.

sources.title: ZUS cash benefits
sources.notes: Identify the benefit and insured role first. Entitlement, waiting periods, contribution record, medical evidence, payer responsibilities, forms and deadlines depend on current facts; inspect personal eZUS records only with user authorization and never infer entitlement.

sources.title: ZUS retirement pensions
sources.notes: Retirement route depends on age, insured periods, account record, work history and international coordination. Verify current conditions, documents, application timing, ZUS appointment need and any EU or bilateral coordination; do not estimate entitlement from incomplete records.

sources.title: ZUS disability and survivor pensions
sources.notes: Distinguish insurance incapacity and survivor pensions from disability-status determinations and social assistance. Verify the exact benefit, insured history, medical or family evidence, international coordination and current filing route; never conflate the authorities.

sources.title: ZUS funeral allowance
sources.notes: Verify who bore funeral costs, the deceased person's insurance or pension relation, current amount rules, documents, deadline and whether ZUS or another pension body is competent. Do not promise payment.

sources.title: Family 800 Plus programme
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: Verify the current benefit period, child's situation, residence or coordination facts, applicant role, available channel and filing date. Never infer entitlement from residence status or parenthood alone.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Active Parent programme
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: The programme has distinct benefit paths. Verify the child's age and care arrangement, parents' activity and residence or coordination facts, current incompatibilities, channel and benefit period; do not select a path without those facts.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Obtain an adult degree-of-disability determination
sources.notes: This determination is distinct from ZUS incapacity decisions and support-level decisions. Verify residence, competent powiat team, medical evidence validity, local submission or appointment practice and review route; never predict the degree awarded.

sources.title: Obtain a disability determination for a child under 16
sources.notes: Use the child-specific route and verify the child's age, guardian authority, competent powiat team, current medical evidence and local appointment practice. Never predict the determination or reuse an adult route.

sources.title: Obtain a disability parking card
sources.notes: A disability decision does not automatically prove parking-card eligibility. Verify the current decision wording, applicant or facility route, competent team, photo and fee, local appointment or collection practice and expiration rules.

sources.title: Obtain the supporting benefit
sources.notes: The support-level decision and the ZUS benefit application are separate stages. Verify age, residence and status facts, finality of the decision, current phased conditions, form and channel; never promise entitlement or amount.

sources.title: PFRON Support Services System
sources.authority: State Fund for Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons
sources.notes: SOW exposes programmes administered through participating local authorities. Availability, calls, budgets, documents and deadlines differ by programme and locality. Verify the user's competent PCPR, MOPR or other unit and the active call before entering personal data or applying.
sources.publisher: State Fund for Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons

sources.title: Obtain a European Health Insurance Card
sources.notes: EKUZ does not replace travel insurance or prove coverage for every treatment. Verify insured status, destination, trip purpose, applicant role, delivery timing and the currently supported IKP or mojeIKP route; submission requires user confirmation.

sources.title: NFZ treatment-date search
sources.notes: Search results are reported provider availability, not a booking or clinical recommendation. Verify the service, referral requirement, location, update date and provider contact details live; contact and booking remain separate actions.

sources.title: Financing healthcare for foreign nationals in Poland
sources.notes: Coverage depends on the person's legal and insurance basis and sometimes international coordination. Verify the current status, payer, employment or family relation, EU documents and urgency; do not delay emergency care or infer entitlement.

sources.title: Psychological and pedagogical counselling in education
sources.notes: Identify the child's school stage, concern and locality. The competent public counselling centre, referral practice, language support, assessment and school implementation vary locally; urgent safety or health concerns require the appropriate immediate route.

sources.title: Rules for foreign nationals studying at Polish higher-education institutions
sources.authority: Ministry of Science and Higher Education
sources.notes: Admission, tuition and scholarship rules depend on citizenship or status, institution and programme. Verify the institution's current admission notice, document recognition and language rules, and separately verify residence consequences; never promise admission or fee treatment.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Science and Higher Education

sources.title: Register with a labour office as unemployed or seeking work
sources.authority: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
sources.notes: Registration category, residence or work-authorisation status, address and competent powiat labour office affect the route. Verify current documents, appointment or online method, benefit consequences and ongoing duties; submission requires user confirmation.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy

sources.title: Obtain a housing allowance
sources.notes: Household, legal title, income, premises and local administration facts matter. Verify current thresholds, calculation period, documents, competent gmina unit and appointment or filing channel; never promise eligibility or amount.

sources.title: Pay local property tax
sources.notes: Rates, account numbers, declarations and local electronic services are set or operated by the gmina. Verify owner or possessor facts, property type, acquisition or change date, current local resolution, competent office and payment identifier before filing or paying.

sources.title: Electricity supply to a household
sources.notes: First classify supplier, distribution operator, billing, meter, contract, disconnection and emergency-safety issues. Verify the current contract and complaint route; supplier choice, local technical operator and municipal heating or water rules differ.

sources.title: Land and mortgage registers
sources.notes: Public viewing requires the correct land-register number. An extract is not a complete legal or transaction-risk opinion. Verify registry currency, relevant sections, pending entries and the competent court or notary route before any property decision or paid document request.

sources.title: Register a vehicle
sources.notes: Verify acquisition or import facts, vehicle origin, owner and representative roles, insurance and inspection records, current deadline, documents, fees and competent starosta or city with powiat rights. Local appointment systems and collection practice vary.

sources.title: Notify acquisition or disposal of a vehicle
sources.notes: Acquisition, registration and disposal notification are not interchangeable. Verify transaction type and date, co-owners, competent office, current notification duty and channel. The user personally performs the declaration; submission requires a fresh action-time confirmation.

sources.title: Check driving penalty points
sources.notes: Penalty-point data is personal. Verify login method and record date; explain but do not infer licence validity or legal consequences, and route discrepancies or imminent sanctions to current official guidance or professional advice.

sources.title: CEPiK public and personal vehicle services
sources.notes: Separate public vehicle-history services from authenticated personal driver or vehicle records. Verify required identifiers, data date and service scope; a registry result does not replace technical inspection, ownership evidence or legal due diligence.

sources.title: Check personal data in the Central Register of Voters
sources.notes: Never infer electoral eligibility from residence alone. Capture citizenship, election type and date, then verify personal register data and current PKW or gov guidance; personal-record access remains user-authorized.

sources.title: Change voting place
sources.notes: Availability and deadline depend on the election calendar and the voter's eligibility. Verify citizenship, election type, current register entry, address and deadline live; the user confirms any register change or application.

sources.title: Court Information Portal and electronic filing changes
sources.notes: The 2026 transition is role-, case- and court-dependent. Verify whether the portal supports the specific filing or delivery, the effective rule, deadline and represented-party role. Never treat viewing a case as authority to file, acknowledge or waive rights.

sources.title: Obtain a certificate from the National Criminal Register
sources.notes: Identify the person or entity, purpose, required scope, recipient and whether electronic or paper output is accepted. Verify current fee, identity and signature method, processing route and foreign-use requirements. The user personally performs any signature; request and payment initiation require fresh action-time confirmation.

sources.title: Complaints to the President of the Personal Data Protection Office
sources.notes: First identify the controller, data, event, prior request and evidence. Verify the current complaint requirements and channel, distinguish regulatory complaint from civil claims or urgent fraud response, and obtain confirmation before sending personal or sensitive evidence.

sources.title: Commissioner for Human Rights: equal treatment
sources.notes: Classify the actor, protected ground, setting, event date and existing proceedings. RPO competence, labour, consumer, criminal and civil routes differ; preserve evidence and verify current complaint and deadline routes without promising intervention.

sources.title: Commissioner for Human Rights: foreign nationals, refugees and migrants
sources.notes: Use for rights orientation and current RPO materials, not as a substitute for residence, protection or court procedure. Identify the authority, act, deadline and any immediate safety issue before selecting an escalation path.

sources.title: Bank Guarantee Fund deposit protection
sources.notes: Verify the institution and product against the current BFG scope and official entity information. Do not assume every fintech balance, investment, foreign branch or similarly branded product is a guaranteed deposit, and do not provide investment advice.

sources.title: Find a Crime Victim Support Network centre
sources.notes: Immediate danger belongs to 112. For non-immediate support, verify the current centre directory, opening and contact method, safe-to-contact preference, language and locality. Do not expose location or send a message when coercion or surveillance is possible.

sources.title: National system of free legal aid
sources.notes: Use this general resident-facing source before the foreigner-specific page. The official system includes local booking and may offer remote, out-of-office or accessibility accommodations, but mode, language, specialist duty, declarations and appointment availability can change in 2026 and vary by point. Verify them live and never infer eligibility or representation.

sources.title: Energy disputes and complaints: consumer competence map
sources.notes: Do not assume URE owns every bill, contract, seller or technical dispute. Classify the energy undertaking, contract holder, point-of-supply locality, prior complaint and requested remedy, then verify whether the current owner is the provider, a territorial URE branch, the negotiation coordinator, a consumer ombudsman or another body. Do not copy volatile fees, addresses or rates into a plan.

locator.value: Spory i skargi - informacje dla konsumentow

sources.title: Search for authorised waste recipients and identify municipal PSZOK ownership
sources.notes: Keep two routes separate: public BDO search for entities authorised for a waste code and the resident's gmina-owned municipal system or PSZOK. Verify the waste type or code, gmina, local rules, limits, opening and any appointment requirement live; a registry result is not permission to deliver waste or proof that a private service is free.

sources.title: Recognition of foreign school certificates and diplomas in Poland
sources.notes: This route concerns school certificates, not NAWA higher-education recognition. Do not decide automatic recognition from the title alone: verify document type, issuing country and agreement, issue date, intended recipient and purpose, then determine whether no procedure or an education-superintendent procedure may apply. Confirm the competent voivodeship, translations, deadline and appointment practice live.

sources.title: Professional qualifications for people coming to Poland
sources.authority: Ministry of Science and Higher Education
sources.notes: First establish whether the profession is regulated and which sector authority owns it. Do not infer recognition, eligibility, document sufficiency or permission to work; application, upload and payment require confirmation.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Science and Higher Education

sources.title: Regulated professions in Poland
sources.authority: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange
sources.notes: Use to distinguish EU, EEA or Swiss qualification routes from third-country routes and to identify the profession-specific authority. It does not decide recognition or work authorization.
sources.publisher: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange

sources.title: Succession in Poland factsheet
sources.authority: European Judicial Network and European Commission
sources.notes: Use as an official orientation source, not to choose heirs, shares, acceptance or rejection, applicable law, venue, court or notary for an individual case.

sources.title: Competent authorities for succession matters in Poland
sources.notes: Use to locate candidate authorities after applicable procedure and territorial competence are established. The atlas is not an individualized venue conclusion.

sources.title: Find a common court
sources.notes: The directory locates courts; it does not establish jurisdiction, venue, case strategy or whether a court rather than a notary owns a succession step.

sources.title: Obtain an adult Polish passport
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: An ordinary adult passport requires the applicant's personal and biometric step. Verify the current office, appointment, documents and payment live; the plugin cannot submit or attest for the user.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: Obtain a temporary Polish passport
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: Do not infer that urgency qualifies the applicant. Verify the current ground, authority, evidence, appointment and destination acceptance; personal attestations and biometric steps stay with the user.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration

sources.title: Polish passports abroad
sources.notes: Mission competence, appointment categories and availability vary. A passport issued by another state belongs to that state's current consular authority.

sources.title: e-Konsulat appointment portal
sources.notes: The user handles credentials and CAPTCHA. A caller-owned operator may inspect scoped availability and prepare fields, but booking and personal-data disclosure require fresh confirmation. Mission categories vary and no connector is bundled.

sources.title: Vehicle technical inspections
sources.notes: Verify vehicle category, inspection type, current due date, authorised station scope and any local booking. Do not infer roadworthiness or safety from a registry entry.

sources.title: Compulsory vehicle third-party liability insurance
sources.notes: Use for official orientation only. Do not choose an insurer, buy a policy, infer coverage or make a legal compliance conclusion.

sources.title: Public check of vehicle OC insurance
sources.notes: A displayed registry result is time-scoped information, not a legal coverage, ownership, safety or due-diligence conclusion. Verify identifiers and data date.

sources.title: Road toll payment routes
sources.notes: Separate e-TOLL, concession motorway and other route/operator branches. Verify exact route, vehicle combination and target date; do not freeze rates or infer liability.

sources.title: e-TOLL system
sources.notes: Verify exact road, vehicle or combination category, target date and current service method. Credentials stay with the user; registration, declarations and payment initiation require confirmation. e-TOLL is not every motorway toll.

sources.title: e-TOLL vehicle classification tool
sources.notes: Use the current official classifier as routing assistance, not a final legal classification. Preserve vehicle and trailer facts and target date.

sources.title: e-TOLL light vehicle with trailer transition from 21 September 2026
sources.notes: A known rule changes on 2026-09-21. Always collect target_date and vehicle-combination facts and verify the transition live before stating the applicable route.

sources.title: Public Roads Act consolidated record
sources.authority: Sejm of the Republic of Poland
sources.notes: Use the current consolidated legal record with the relevant local resolution, road manager and signage. Do not turn it into an individualized toll or parking conclusion.
sources.publisher: Sejm of the Republic of Poland

sources.title: Import formalities on PUESC
sources.notes: Separate non-EU import from intra-EU acquisition and registration. Do not infer tariff classification, valuation, relief or customs outcome. Signature, upload, submission and payment remain confirmation-gated or user-only.

sources.title: Excise information for passenger cars
sources.notes: Use the current Samochody osobowe heading. Do not freeze rates or decide classification, valuation, exemption, tax base or liability for the user.

sources.title: Submit a passenger-car excise declaration and obtain payment confirmation
sources.notes: A caller-owned operator may prepare the scoped AKC-US route after the user authenticates. The user personally signs attestations; upload, submission and payment initiation require fresh confirmation. No PUESC connector is bundled.

sources.title: Territorial self-government unit directory
sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
sources.notes: The current JST base identifies territorial units and contact data; it does not prove procedural competence. Classify the national procedure level, then verify the exact department and channel in the local BIP. Handle cities with powiat rights and Warsaw districts explicitly.
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Administration
